description.value: The Boston Bar Library is a small community branch of the Fraser Valley Regional Library, the largest public library system in British Columbia, serving the Boston Bar and surrounding Nlaka'pamux territory. Cyclists passing through this remote Fraser Canyon community can stop in for free WiFi, public computers, and copying/printing/scanning services. The branch offers outdoor bike racks, making it a practical rest stop on an otherwise isolated stretch of highway.

address.value: 47632 Old Boston Bar Road, Boston Bar, BC V0K 1C0
